workflows..github/workflows/main.yml:
name: main
concurrency:
  group: main-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ inputs.candidate_sha || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  update-pr-branches:
    name: update PR branches
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.candidate_sha == ''
    permissions:
      contents: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/pr-branch-updater.yml
    secrets:
      RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
  quality:
    name: quality
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      security-events: write
    uses: mickey-kras/hindsight-memory-router-integrations/.github/workflows/trusted-ci.yml@533e79de3119fadf50c7f299305d01eebb933abf
    with:
      revision_sha: ${{ inputs.candidate_sha }}
      revision_ref: ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
  aislop:
    name: aislop
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      security-events: write
    uses: mickey-kras/hindsight-memory-router-integrations/.github/workflows/trusted-aislop.yml@533e79de3119fadf50c7f299305d01eebb933abf
    with:
      revision_sha: ${{ inputs.candidate_sha }}
      revision_ref: ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
  codeql:
    name: codeql
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      security-events: write
    uses: mickey-kras/hindsight-memory-router-integrations/.github/workflows/trusted-codeql.yml@533e79de3119fadf50c7f299305d01eebb933abf
    with:
      revision_sha: ${{ inputs.candidate_sha }}
      revision_ref: ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
  sonar:
    name: sonar
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.candidate_sha == ''
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      issues: write
    needs:
      - quality
      - aislop
      - codeql
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: step-security/harden-runner@dc2769abcc0fcfbadfc1df54081c1608579ef6b2
        with:
          egress-policy: audit
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ inputs.candidate_sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Mask configured SonarQube endpoint
        env:
          SONAR_HOST_URL: ${{ secrets.SONAR_HOST_URL }}
        run: python3 .github/scripts/mask-sonar-context.py configured
      - name: Connect to the tailnet
        uses: tailscale/github-action@d1b6cd204f8dceda5b3eaad7f1f767be390056cd
        with:
          oauth-client-id: ${{ secrets.TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID }}
          audience: ${{ secrets.TAILSCALE_AUDIENCE }}
          tags: tag:github-sonar
          use-cache: 'true'
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1
        with:
          node-version: 22.23.3
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Install SonarQube analysis dependencies
        run: |
          npm install --global npm@11.19.1 --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          test "$(npm --version)" = 11.19.1
          npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          npm ci --prefix src/upstream/coding-agents --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Require successful coverage artifact
        env:
          COVERAGE_ARTIFACT_ID: ${{ needs.quality.outputs.coverage_artifact }}
        run: test -n "$COVERAGE_ARTIFACT_ID"
      - name: Restore verified coverage
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333
        with:
          artifact-ids: ${{ needs.quality.outputs.coverage_artifact }}
          path: coverage
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Verify coverage provenance
        env:
          COVERAGE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: node .github/scripts/coverage-artifact.cjs verify
      - name: Mask advertised SonarQube endpoint
        env:
          SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}
          SONAR_HOST_URL: ${{ secrets.SONAR_HOST_URL }}
        run: python3 .github/scripts/mask-sonar-context.py advertised
      - name: SonarQube analysis
        uses: SonarSource/sonarqube-scan-action@d209202bc7d53ff1cc128f7f907dac145c9d6ae9
        env:
          SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}
          SONAR_HOST_URL: ${{ secrets.SONAR_HOST_URL }}
      - name: SonarQube quality gate
        id: sonar-quality-gate
        timeout-minutes: 6
        uses: SonarSource/sonarqube-quality-gate-action@7a5fffe8e523c40e0c740b6bc2712ab503e52efa
        with:
          pollingTimeoutSec: 270
        env:
          SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}
          SONAR_HOST_URL: ${{ secrets.SONAR_HOST_URL }}
      - name: Synchronize SonarQube findings
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && failure() && steps.sonar-quality-gate.outcome == 'failure' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
          }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}
          SONAR_HOST_URL: ${{ secrets.SONAR_HOST_URL }}
        run: python3 .github/scripts/sync-sonar-findings.py .scannerwork/report-task.txt
  publish:
    name: publish packages
    needs:
      - quality
      - aislop
      - codeql
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.candidate_sha != ''
    outputs:
      released: ${{ steps.finalized.outputs.latest }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 50
    environment: release-automation
    concurrency:
      group: package-release-${{ github.repository }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
      actions: read
    env:
      RELEASE_APP_ID: ${{ vars.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
      RELEASE_SETTINGS_REVIEW: ${{ vars.RELEASE_SETTINGS_REVIEW }}
      CANDIDATE_REF: ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
      CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ inputs.candidate_sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: step-security/harden-runner@dc2769abcc0fcfbadfc1df54081c1608579ef6b2
        with:
          egress-policy: audit
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ inputs.candidate_sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1
        with:
          node-version: 22.23.3
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Resolve retained packages
        id: retained
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        with:
          script: |
            await require('./.github/scripts/release.cjs').retryPackages({
              github, context, core,
              target: { ref: process.env.CANDIDATE_REF, sha: process.env.CANDIDATE_SHA },
            });
      - name: Restore retained packages
        if: steps.retained.outputs.artifact != ''
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333
        with:
          artifact-ids: ${{ steps.retained.outputs.artifact }}
          path: packages
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Build and verify packages
        if: steps.retained.outputs.artifact == ''
        run: |
          npm install --global npm@11.19.1 --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          test "$(npm --version)" = 11.19.1
          npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          npm ci --prefix src/upstream/coding-agents --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          npm run build
          npm run build:coding-agents
          mkdir -p packages
          npm pack --pack-destination packages --silent
          (cd src/upstream/coding-agents && npm pack --pack-destination "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/packages" --silent)
          node .github/scripts/verify-package-inventory.cjs
          sha256sum --check PACKAGE_SHA256
      - name: Verify retained package inventory
        run: |
          node .github/scripts/verify-package-inventory.cjs
          sha256sum --check PACKAGE_SHA256
      - name: Retain tested packages
        if: steps.retained.outputs.artifact == ''
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
        with:
          name: packages-${{ inputs.candidate_sha }}
          path: packages/*.tgz
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Release preflight
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        with:
          script: |
            await require('./.github/scripts/release.cjs').validate({
              github, context, core,
              target: { ref: process.env.CANDIDATE_REF, sha: process.env.CANDIDATE_SHA },
            });
      - name: Install release tools
        run: npm ci --prefix .github/scripts --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Candidate provenance
        id: provenance
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        with:
          script: |
            await require('./.github/scripts/release.cjs').candidateProvenance({
              github, context, core,
              target: { ref: process.env.CANDIDATE_REF, sha: process.env.CANDIDATE_SHA },
            });
      - name: Attest tested packages
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8
        with:
          subject-path: packages/*.tgz
          predicate-path: ${{ steps.provenance.outputs.path }}
          predicate-type: ${{ steps.provenance.outputs.type }}
          create-storage-record: true
      - name: Release App token
        id: app
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@64ab729a6294000f5aa4a4bc0b73d1f32bc45510
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          repositories: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
          permission-contents: write
          permission-pull-requests: write
      - name: Publish immutable release
        id: finalized
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        with:
          github-token: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}
          script: |
            await require('./.github/scripts/release.cjs').finalize({
              github, context, core,
              target: { ref: process.env.CANDIDATE_REF, sha: process.env.CANDIDATE_SHA },
            });
      - name: Publish verified tarballs to public npm
        run: |
          npm install --global npm@11.19.1 --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          test "$(npm --version)" = 11.19.1
          node .github/scripts/publish-npm.cjs
      - name: Queue next version
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}
        with:
          github-token: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}
          script: |
            await require('./.github/scripts/release-follow-up.cjs').bumpReleasedVersion({
              github, context, core,
              target: { ref: process.env.CANDIDATE_REF, sha: process.env.CANDIDATE_SHA },
            });
      - name: Delete published candidate
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        with:
          github-token: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}
          script: |
            await require('./.github/scripts/release-follow-up.cjs').deletePublishedBranch({
              github, context, core,
              target: { ref: process.env.CANDIDATE_REF, sha: process.env.CANDIDATE_SHA },
            });
'on':
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      candidate_ref:
        type: string
        default: ''
      candidate_sha:
        type: string
        default: ''
    secrets:
      RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY:
        required: false
      TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID:
        required: false
      TAILSCALE_AUDIENCE:
        required: false
      SONAR_TOKEN:
        required: false
      SONAR_HOST_URL:
        required: false
  workflow_dispatch: null
  push:
    branches:
      - main
workflows..github/workflows/pr-validation.yml:
name: PR validation
permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  security-events: write
concurrency:
  group: pr-validation-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || inputs.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  docs-ste:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/docs-ste.yml
    permissions:
      contents: read
  guard:
    name: guard
    needs: [docs-ste]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    steps:
      - name: Require documentation checks
        env:
          DOCS_STE: ${{ needs.docs-ste.result }}
        run: test "$DOCS_STE" = success
      - uses: step-security/harden-runner@dc2769abcc0fcfbadfc1df54081c1608579ef6b2
        with:
          egress-policy: audit
      - name: Read the trusted main policy
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
          path: automation
          sparse-checkout: .github
      - name: Validate PR with the trusted policy
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          CI_POLICY_SETTINGS_REVIEW: ${{ vars.CI_POLICY_SETTINGS_REVIEW }}
        with:
          script: |
            const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process');
            const { runPolicy, runDispatchedPolicy } = require('./automation/.github/scripts/dependabot-validation.cjs');
            const mainSha = execFileSync('git', ['-C', 'automation', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim();
            async function runPullRequestPolicy(github, context, core, trustedMainSha, policy = runPolicy) {
              const expected = context.payload.pull_request;
              if (context.eventName !== "pull_request" || !Number.isSafeInteger(expected?.number)) {
                throw new Error("Policy job requires a pull request event");
              }
              const params = { ...context.repo, pull_number: expected.number };
              const { data: current } = await github.rest.pulls.get(params);
              if (
                current.state !== "open" || current.base.ref !== "main" ||
                current.head.sha !== expected.head.sha || current.base.sha !== expected.base.sha ||
                current.base.sha !== trustedMainSha || context.ref !== `refs/pull/${current.number}/merge`
              ) throw new Error("PR head or trusted policy revision changed");
              const files = await github.paginate(github.rest.pulls.listFiles, { ...params, per_page: 100 });
              await policy(github, context.repo, current, files, { live: true });
              const { data: latest } = await github.rest.pulls.get(params);
              if (latest.state !== "open" || latest.head.sha !== current.head.sha || latest.base.sha !== current.base.sha) {
                throw new Error("PR changed during policy validation");
              }
              core.info(`#${current.number}: trusted policy passed at ${current.head.sha}`);
            }
            const run = context.eventName === 'pull_request' ? runPullRequestPolicy : runDispatchedPolicy;
            await run(github, context, core, mainSha);
  quality:
    uses: mickey-kras/hindsight-memory-router-integrations/.github/workflows/trusted-ci.yml@533e79de3119fadf50c7f299305d01eebb933abf
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      security-events: write
  aislop:
    uses: mickey-kras/hindsight-memory-router-integrations/.github/workflows/trusted-aislop.yml@533e79de3119fadf50c7f299305d01eebb933abf
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      security-events: write
  codeql:
    uses: mickey-kras/hindsight-memory-router-integrations/.github/workflows/trusted-codeql.yml@533e79de3119fadf50c7f299305d01eebb933abf
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      security-events: write
  branch-policy:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/branch-policy.yml
  dependabot-policy:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/dependabot-policy-tests.yml
'on':
  pull_request:
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize
      - reopened
      - ready_for_review
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      number:
        description: Dependabot PR number
        required: true
      expected_head:
        description: Prepared Dependabot commit
        required: true
workflows..github/workflows/release.yml:
name: release
concurrency:
  group: dependabot-auto-merge-${{ github.repository }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  entry:
    name: require main
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions: {}
    steps:
      - name: Reject release dispatches outside main
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        with:
          script: |
            if (context.eventName !== 'workflow_dispatch' || context.ref !== 'refs/heads/main') {
              throw new Error('Release dispatch is allowed only from main');
            }
  baseline:
    name: validate main
    needs: entry
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      security-events: write
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
      issues: write
      pull-requests: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/main.yml
    secrets:
      TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID }}
      TAILSCALE_AUDIENCE: ${{ secrets.TAILSCALE_AUDIENCE }}
      SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}
      SONAR_HOST_URL: ${{ secrets.SONAR_HOST_URL }}
      RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
  prepare-release:
    name: prepare candidate
    needs: baseline
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    environment: release-automation
    outputs:
      sha: ${{ steps.prepared.outputs.sha }}
      ref: ${{ steps.prepared.outputs.ref }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    env:
      RELEASE_APP_ID: ${{ vars.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
      RELEASE_SETTINGS_REVIEW: ${{ vars.RELEASE_SETTINGS_REVIEW }}
    steps:
      - uses: step-security/harden-runner@dc2769abcc0fcfbadfc1df54081c1608579ef6b2
        with:
          egress-policy: audit
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Validate release entry point
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        with:
          script: require('./.github/scripts/release.cjs').dispatchContext(context);
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@594f3bf4285d9ea8dc53c9a0c9c4092420091003
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1
        with:
          node-version: 22.23.3
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Build and verify packages
        run: |
          npm install --global npm@11.19.1 --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          test "$(npm --version)" = 11.19.1
          npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          npm ci --prefix src/upstream/coding-agents --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          npm run build
          npm run build:coding-agents
          mkdir -p packages
          npm pack --pack-destination packages --silent
          (cd src/upstream/coding-agents && npm pack --pack-destination "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/packages" --silent)
          node .github/scripts/verify-package-inventory.cjs
          sha256sum --check PACKAGE_SHA256
      - name: Install release tools
        run: npm ci --prefix .github/scripts --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Release App token
        id: app
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@64ab729a6294000f5aa4a4bc0b73d1f32bc45510
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          repositories: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
          permission-contents: write
      - name: Freeze inputs and create release branch
        id: prepared
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        with:
          github-token: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}
          script: await require('./.github/scripts/release.cjs').prepare({ github, context, core });
      - name: Resolve retained preparation packages
        if: steps.prepared.outputs.sha != ''
        id: retained
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        env:
          CANDIDATE_REF: ${{ steps.prepared.outputs.ref }}
          CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ steps.prepared.outputs.sha }}
        with:
          script: |
            await require('./.github/scripts/release.cjs').retryPackages({
              github, context, core,
              target: { ref: process.env.CANDIDATE_REF, sha: process.env.CANDIDATE_SHA },
            });
      - name: Retain prepared packages
        if: steps.prepared.outputs.sha != '' && steps.retained.outputs.artifact == ''
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
        with:
          name: packages-${{ steps.prepared.outputs.sha }}
          path: packages/*.tgz
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Resume the prepared release
        if: steps.prepared.outputs.resume_sha != ''
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        env:
          RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ steps.prepared.outputs.version }}
          RELEASE_SHA: ${{ steps.prepared.outputs.resume_sha }}
          RELEASE_RUN: ${{ steps.prepared.outputs.resume_run }}
        with:
          script: |
            await require('./.github/scripts/release.cjs').resumePreparedRelease({
              github, context, core, version: process.env.RELEASE_VERSION, sha: process.env.RELEASE_SHA,
              runId: process.env.RELEASE_RUN ? Number(process.env.RELEASE_RUN) : undefined,
            });
  release:
    name: validate and publish candidate
    needs: prepare-release
    if: needs.prepare-release.outputs.sha != ''
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      security-events: write
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
      issues: write
      pull-requests: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/main.yml
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ needs.prepare-release.outputs.sha }}
      candidate_ref: ${{ needs.prepare-release.outputs.ref }}
    secrets:
      RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
  retain-preparation:
    name: retain failed preparation
    needs: prepare-release
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && needs.prepare-release.result == 'failure' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3
        with:
          script: await require('./.github/scripts/release-cleanup.cjs').preparation({ github, context, core });
'on':
  workflow_dispatch: null

name: ci

    inputs:
      candidate_ref:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:

"""Exercise release policy against meaningful workflow and source mutations."""

import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shlex
import sys
import tempfile
import subprocess
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

import yaml

ROOT = Path.cwd()
GUARD = ROOT / ".github/workflows/policy-guard.yml"
ROUTER = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/publish.yml").exists()
MAIN = ".github/workflows/publish.yml" if ROUTER else ".github/workflows/main.yml"
ACTIVE = "trusted-ci.yml@" in (ROOT / MAIN).read_text()
CI = ".github/workflows/trusted-ci.yml" if ACTIVE else ".github/workflows/ci.yml"
BUILD = "build" if ACTIVE else "checks"
SECURITY = "security" if ACTIVE else "checks"
PATHS = [
    ".github/dependency-review-config.yml",
    ".github/workflows/policy-guard.yml",
    MAIN,
    ".github/workflows/release.yml",
    ".github/workflows/ci.yml",
    ".github/workflows/pr-validation.yml",
    ".github/workflows/branch-policy.yml",
    ".github/workflows/aislop.yml",
    ".github/workflows/codeql.yml",
    ".github/workflows/pr-branch-updater.yml",
    ".github/scripts/package.json",
    ".github/scripts/package-lock.json",
    ".github/scripts/combination.cjs",
    ".github/scripts/combination-identity.cjs",
    ".github/scripts/combination-smoke.sh",
    ".github/scripts/combination-smoke.mjs",
    ".github/scripts/combination.test.cjs",
    ".github/scripts/release.test.cjs",
    ".github/scripts/release-policy.test.py",
    ".github/scripts/release.cjs",
    ".github/scripts/coverage-artifact.cjs",
    ".github/scripts/coverage-artifact.test.cjs",
    ".github/scripts/release-follow-up.cjs",
    ".github/scripts/release-settings.cjs",
    ".github/rulesets/protect-release-branches.json",
]
if ROUTER:
    PATHS.append(".github/scripts/publish-image.sh")
else:
    PATHS.append(".github/scripts/release-cleanup.cjs")
    PATHS.append(".github/scripts/release-cleanup.test.cjs")


PATHS.extend(str(path.relative_to(ROOT)) for path in (ROOT / ".github/workflows").glob("trusted-*.yml"))

def policy(overrides=None):
    files = {
        str(path.relative_to(ROOT)): path.read_text()
        for path in (ROOT / ".github").rglob("*")
        if "node_modules" not in path.parts and path.is_file() and path.suffix in {".yml", ".yaml", ".cjs", ".mjs", ".py", ".sh", ".json"}
    }
    files["package.json"] = (ROOT / "package.json").read_text()
    files.update(overrides or {})
    guard = yaml.safe_load(GUARD.read_text())
    steps = guard["jobs"]["guard"]["steps"]
    if ROUTER:
        script = next(step["with"]["script"] for step in steps if "with" in step)
        driver = r"""
const input = JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf8'));
const failures = [];
const github = { paginate: async () => input.paths.map(filename => ({filename, status: 'modified'})),
  rest: { pulls: {listFiles() {}}, repos: {getContent: async ({path}) => ({data: {
    content: Buffer.from(input.files[path]).toString('base64'), encoding: 'base64'
  }})}}};
const context = {repo: {owner: 'test', repo: 'test'}, payload: {pull_request: {number: 1, head: {sha: 'test'}}}};
const core = {setFailed: text => failures.push(text), info() {}};
const AsyncFunction = Object.getPrototypeOf(async function(){}).constructor;
new AsyncFunction('github', 'context', 'core', 'require', input.script)(github, context, core, require)
  .then(() => process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(failures))).catch(error => {console.error(error); process.exit(1);});
"""
        result = subprocess.run(
            ["node", "-e", driver],
            input=json.dumps({"script": script, "files": files, "paths": PATHS}),
            text=True,
            capture_output=True,
            check=True,
        )
        return json.loads(result.stdout)
    source = ""
    for step in steps:
        run = step.get("run", "")
        if "cat <<'POLICY_SOURCE'" in run:
            source += run.split("\n", 2)[2].rsplit("\nPOLICY_SOURCE", 1)[0] + "\n"
    # Exercise the guard's existing fixture mode in its own process, including
    # its real author checks and main entry point. Do not evaluate source in the
    # test runner or disable the repository's dynamic-execution security rule.
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="release-policy-") as temporary:
        directory = Path(temporary)
        program = directory / "policy_guard.py"
        program.write_text(source)
        fixtures = directory / "fixtures"
        fixtures.mkdir()
        for path, content in files.items():
            target = fixtures / path
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content)
        for name, value in {
            "head_sha": "a" * 40,
            "author_association": "OWNER",
            "author_login": "test-owner",
        }.items():
            (fixtures / name).write_text(value)
        changed = directory / "files.json"
        changed.write_text(json.dumps([{"filename": path, "status": "modified"} for path in PATHS]))
        result = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, str(program)],
            env={**os.environ, "GUARD_FIXTURE_DIR": str(fixtures), "FILES_JSON": str(changed)},
            text=True,
            capture_output=True,
            timeout=30,
            check=False,
        )
        return [] if result.returncode == 0 else [result.stdout + result.stderr]

                for step in job["steps"]:
                    for line in step.get("run", "").splitlines():
                        if not line.strip().startswith("npm ci"):

                        command = shlex.split(line)
                        if command[:2] == ["npm", "ci"]:

        ci = yaml.safe_load((ROOT / CI).read_text())
        steps = {step.get("name"): step for step in ci["jobs"][BUILD]["steps"]}
        script = steps["Nix dependency hash"]["run"]
        # Exercise the actual workflow shell with an offline Nix boundary.
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="nix-hash-") as temporary:
            directory = Path(temporary)
            (directory / "packages").mkdir()
            (directory / "packages/root.tgz").write_bytes(b"verified tarball")
            (directory / "bin").mkdir()
            nix = directory / "bin/nix"
            nix.write_text("""#!/usr/bin/env python3
import base64, hashlib, json, os, sys
from pathlib import Path
with Path('calls').open('a') as log:
    log.write(json.dumps(sys.argv[1:]) + '\\n')
if sys.argv[1:3] == ['hash', 'file']:
    print('sha256-' + base64.b64encode(hashlib.sha256(Path(sys.argv[3]).read_bytes()).digest()).decode())
elif sys.argv[1:] == ['run', 'github:NixOS/nixpkgs/' + os.environ['NIXPKGS_REV'] + '#prefetch-npm-deps', '--', 'npm-shrinkwrap.json']:
    print('sha256-dependencies')
else:
    sys.exit('Unexpected Nix command')
""")
            nix.chmod(0o755)
            source = "sha256-" + base64.b64encode(hashlib.sha256(b"verified tarball").digest()).decode()
            cache = directory / "nix-prefetch/npm-deps"
            environment = {
                **os.environ,
                "PATH": f"{directory / 'bin'}:{os.environ['PATH']}",
                "RUNNER_TEMP": temporary,
                "ROOT_ARTIFACT": "root.tgz",
                "NIXPKGS_REV": ci["jobs"][BUILD]["env"]["NIXPKGS_REV"],
            }
            for hit, expected_source, expected_deps, cached, success in [
                ("false", source, "sha256-dependencies", None, True),
                ("true", source, "sha256-dependencies", "sha256-dependencies", True),
                ("true", "sha256-wrong-source", "sha256-dependencies", "sha256-dependencies", False),
                ("true", source, "sha256-new-dependencies", "sha256-dependencies", False),
                ("true", source, "sha256-dependencies", None, False),
                ("false", source, "sha256-dependencies", "stale-prefix-match", True),
            ]:
                with self.subTest(hit=hit, source=expected_source, deps=expected_deps, cached=cached):
                    cache.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
                    cache.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                    if cached is not None:
                        cache.write_text(cached + "\n")
                    (directory / "calls").write_text("")
                    (directory / "PACKAGE_NIX_HASHES").write_text(
                        f"source={expected_source}\nnpm_deps={expected_deps}\n")
                    result = subprocess.run(
                        ["bash", "-euo", "pipefail", "-c", script], cwd=directory,
                        env={**environment, "PREFETCH_CACHE_HIT": hit},
                        capture_output=True, text=True, check=False,
                    )
                    self.assertEqual(result.returncode == 0, success, result.stderr)
                    calls = [json.loads(line) for line in (directory / "calls").read_text().splitlines()]
                    self.assertEqual(calls[0], ["hash", "file", "packages/root.tgz"])
                    self.assertEqual(sum(call[0] == "run" for call in calls), 0 if hit == "true" else 1)

    def test_nix_cache_cannot_replace_source_validation_or_tool_identity(self):
        path = CI
        original = (ROOT / path).read_text()
        ci = yaml.safe_load(original)
        steps = {step.get("name"): step for step in ci["jobs"][BUILD]["steps"]}
        cache = steps["Cache Nix dependency hash"]["with"]
        self.assertNotIn("restore-keys", cache)
        for identity in ["runner.os", "runner.arch", "env.NIXPKGS_REV", "hashFiles('npm-shrinkwrap.json')"]:
            self.assertIn(identity, cache["key"])
        self.assertNotIn("npm pack", steps["Nix dependency hash"]["run"])
        self.assertNotIn("if", steps["Nix dependency hash"])
        for old, new in [
            ('test "$(nix hash file "packages/$ROOT_ARTIFACT")" = "$expected_source"', "true"),
            ('test "$actual_deps" = "$expected_deps"', "true"),
            ("${{ env.NIXPKGS_REV }}", "unpinned"),
        ]:
            changed = original.replace(old, new)
            self.assertNotEqual(changed, original)
            self.assertTrue(policy({path: changed}))

    def test_shape_gates_protect_former_detailed_dispatch(self):
        for path, old, new in [
            (CI, "run: npm run test:coverage", "run: true"),
            (MAIN, "pollingTimeoutSec: 270", "pollingTimeoutSec: 0"),
            (".github/workflows/branch-policy.yml", "            exit 1", "            exit 0"),
        ]:
            with self.subTest(path=path):
                original = (ROOT / path).read_text()
                changed = original.replace(old, new)
                self.assertNotEqual(changed, original)
                failures = policy({path: changed})
                self.assertTrue(failures)
                self.assertIn("automation must match its reviewed workflow shape", "\n".join(failures))
        path = ".github/workflows/pr-validation.yml"
        doc = yaml.safe_load((ROOT / path).read_text())
        doc["jobs"]["quality"]["if"] = False
        self.assertTrue(policy({path: yaml.safe_dump(doc)}))

    def test_runner_jobs_are_bounded_without_cancelling_mutations(self):
        for path in (ROOT / ".github/workflows").glob("*.yml"):
            doc = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text())
            for name, job in doc.get("jobs", {}).items():
                if "runs-on" in job:
                    with self.subTest(path=path.name, job=name):
                        self.assertGreater(job.get("timeout-minutes", 0), 0)
                        self.assertLessEqual(job["timeout-minutes"], 30)
        for name in ["main", "release", "dependabot-preparation", "dependabot-auto-merge"]:
            doc = yaml.safe_load((ROOT / f".github/workflows/{name}.yml").read_text())
            self.assertIs(doc["concurrency"]["cancel-in-progress"], False)
        guard = yaml.safe_load(GUARD.read_text())
        self.assertIn("github.event.pull_request.number", guard["concurrency"]["group"])
        self.assertIs(guard["concurrency"]["cancel-in-progress"], True)
